description:
Implement a database audit logging system on the 'customers' table in the Chinook database. 

1. Create a new DBeaver connection named 'ChinookTriggers' (case-sensitive) to the SQLite database located at '/home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook_triggers.db'.

2. Create a new table named 'audit_log' with columns: log_id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY), table_name (TEXT), operation (TEXT), record_id (INTEGER), old_values (TEXT), new_values (TEXT), changed_at (TEXT DEFAULT datetime('now')).

3. Create three AFTER triggers on the 'customers' table to log changes into 'audit_log':
   - INSERT: Log operation='INSERT', record_id=NEW.CustomerId, new_values=FirstName/Email.
   - UPDATE: Log operation='UPDATE', record_id=OLD.CustomerId, old_values=OLD.Email, new_values=NEW.Email.
   - DELETE: Log operation='DELETE', record_id=OLD.CustomerId, old_values=OLD.FirstName/Email.

4. Execute these specific test operations in order:
   A. INSERT a new customer (Id: 60, Name: Alice Wonderland, Email: alice@wonderland.com, Address: 123 Rabbit Hole).
   B. UPDATE CustomerId 1 (Luís Gonçalves) to change Email to 'luis.goncalves@updated.com'.
   C. DELETE the new customer (CustomerId 60).

5. Export the 'audit_log' table to '/home/ga/Documents/exports/audit_log.csv' (with headers).

6. Save your SQL script (DDL + Test DML) to '/home/ga/Documents/scripts/audit_triggers.sql'.
